endpoints.name: Me
endpoints.description: The account the credentials belong to, with its plan and language. One record, and the plan matters because several endpoints here are plan-gated.

endpoints.name: User Workgroups
endpoints.description: The workgroups one user belongs to. Requires a user id.

endpoints.name: Shared
endpoints.description: The resources shared with one user, by resource type. Requires a user id. The access view, and the reason two users see different survey lists.

endpoints.name: Groups
endpoints.description: The groups on the account -- SurveyMonkey's team container.

endpoints.name: Group
endpoints.description: One group by id.

endpoints.name: Group Members
endpoints.description: The members of one group. Requires a group id.

endpoints.name: Group Member
endpoints.description: One group member by id.

endpoints.name: Surveys
endpoints.description: The surveys on the account, with title, the counts of questions, pages and responses, and the created and modified dates. THE RESPONSE COUNT HERE IS THE CHEAPEST ANSWER to how many people replied; everything below it costs more. Filterable by title and modified date.

endpoints.name: Survey
endpoints.description: One survey by id, with its top-level detail and counts.

endpoints.name: Survey Details
endpoints.description: One survey WITH its full structure inlined -- every page, question, answer choice and row, in one response. Requires a survey id. THE ENDPOINT THAT MAKES RESPONSES READABLE: a response returns answers as question ids and choice ids, so without this the data is a graph of opaque identifiers. It replaces walking pages and questions separately.

endpoints.name: Survey Categories
endpoints.description: The categories SurveyMonkey publishes for template browsing. Reference data.

endpoints.name: Survey Template
endpoints.description: The survey templates available, by category and language. Reference content rather than account data.

endpoints.name: All Languages
endpoints.description: The languages SurveyMonkey supports. Reference data.

endpoints.name: Survey Pages
endpoints.description: The pages of one survey. Requires a survey id. The structural level between survey and question.

endpoints.name: Survey Page
endpoints.description: One page by id.

endpoints.name: Survey Questions
endpoints.description: The questions on one page, with their family and subtype, headings, and answer choices. Requires the survey and page ids. THE QUESTION FAMILY DECIDES HOW ITS ANSWERS ARE SHAPED -- single choice, multiple choice, matrix, open ended and demographic all store answers differently, so a single parsing rule does not work across a survey.

endpoints.name: Survey Question
endpoints.description: One question by id, with its choices.

endpoints.name: Questions
endpoints.description: The question bank -- SurveyMonkey's library of pre-written questions, searchable by locale. Reference content for building surveys, not account data.

endpoints.name: Survey Folders
endpoints.description: The folders surveys are organised into.

endpoints.name: Survey Languages
endpoints.description: The languages one survey is translated into. Requires a survey id.

endpoints.name: Survey Language
endpoints.description: One language version of a survey, and whether it is enabled.

endpoints.name: Contact Lists
endpoints.description: The contact lists used for email collectors. The audience container.

endpoints.name: Contact List
endpoints.description: One contact list by id.

endpoints.name: Contact List Contact
endpoints.description: The contacts on one list, filterable by status. Requires a list id.

endpoints.name: Bulk Contact
endpoints.description: The contacts on one list in bulk. Requires a list id. The extract route for a large list.

endpoints.name: Contacts
endpoints.description: All contacts on the account, filterable by status and search term. Status separates active from opted out and bounced -- and opted-out contacts cannot be invited, so a mailable audience count has to exclude them.

endpoints.name: Bulk Contacts
endpoints.description: All contacts in bulk. The account-wide extract route.

endpoints.name: Contact
endpoints.description: One contact by id.

endpoints.name: Contact Fields
endpoints.description: The custom fields defined on contacts. The decoder for custom values.

endpoints.name: Contact Field
endpoints.description: One contact field by id.

endpoints.name: Survey Collectors
endpoints.description: The collectors of one survey -- the channels it was distributed through, such as a web link, email invitation or embedded widget. Requires a survey id. THE COLLECTOR IS THE DIMENSION MOST RESPONSE ANALYSIS NEEDS: the same survey sent by email and posted as a link produces very different response profiles, and only the collector distinguishes them.

endpoints.name: Collector
endpoints.description: One collector by id, with its type, status and response count.

endpoints.name: Collector Messages
endpoints.description: The email invitations and reminders sent through one collector. Requires a collector id. Where the send that produced a batch of responses is recorded.

endpoints.name: Collector Message
endpoints.description: One message by id.

endpoints.name: Message Recipients
endpoints.description: Who one message was sent to. Requires the collector and message ids.

endpoints.name: Recipients
endpoints.description: Everyone invited through one collector, with their status -- sent, opened, responded, bounced, opted out. Requires a collector id. THE DENOMINATOR FOR A RESPONSE RATE, which the responses alone cannot give.

endpoints.name: Recipient
endpoints.description: One recipient by id.

endpoints.name: Stats
endpoints.description: The aggregate statistics of one collector -- sent, opened, clicked, responded, bounced, opted out. Requires a collector id. Response rate without paging recipients.

endpoints.name: Message Stats
endpoints.description: The same statistics for one individual message. Requires the collector and message ids. Which send performed, as opposed to the collector overall.

endpoints.name: Survey Responses
endpoints.description: The responses to one survey, with the respondent, collector, status, and the dates started and modified -- but NOT the answers. Requires a survey id. The index; answers come from the details variants below.

endpoints.name: Collector Responses
endpoints.suffix: /collectors/{Collector ID}/responses?start_created_at={Start Created At?}&end_created_at={End Created At?}&start_modified_at={Start Modified At?}&end_modified_at={End Modified At?}&status={Status?}&email={Email?}&first_name={First Name}&last_name={Last Name}&ip={IP?}&custom={Custom?}&total_time_max={Total Time Max?}&total_time_min={Total Time Min?}&total_time_units={Total Time Units?}
endpoints.description: The responses gathered through one collector. Requires a collector id. The per-channel slice.

endpoints.name: Bulk Collector Responses
endpoints.suffix: /collectors/{Collector ID}/responses/bulk?simple={Simple?}&collector_ids={Collector IDs?}&start_created_at={Start Created At?}&end_created_at={End Created At?}&start_modified_at={Start Modified At?}&end_modified_at={End Modified At?}&status={Status?}&email={Email?}&first_name={First Name?}&last_name={Last Name?}&ip={IP?}&custom={Custom?}&total_time_max={Total Time Max?}&total_time_min={Total Time Min?}&total_time_units={Total Time Units?}&page_ids={Page IDs?}&question_ids={Question IDs?}
endpoints.description: Every response through one collector with answers, paged. The per-channel bulk extract.

endpoints.name: Bulk Survey Responses
endpoints.suffix: /surveys/{Survey ID}/responses/bulk?simple={Simple?}&collector_ids={Collector IDs?}&start_created_at={Start Created At?}&end_created_at={End Created At?}&start_modified_at={Start Modified At?}&end_modified_at={End Modified At?}&status={Status?}&email={Email?}&first_name={First Name?}&last_name={Last Name?}&ip={IP?}&custom={Custom?}&total_time_max={Total Time Max?}&total_time_min={Total Time Min?}&total_time_units={Total Time Units?}&page_ids={Page IDs?}&question_ids={Question IDs?}
endpoints.description: Every response to one survey WITH answers, in one paged request. Requires a survey id. THE PRACTICAL EXTRACT ROUTE -- fetching details one response at a time is prohibitive on any real survey. The simple parameter returns answers as text rather than ids, which trades fidelity for readability.

endpoints.name: Survey Response
endpoints.description: One response by id, without its answers.

endpoints.name: Collector Response
endpoints.suffix: /collectors/{Collector ID}/responses/{Response ID}?survey_id={Survey ID?}&collector_id={Collector ID?}&recipient_id={Recipient ID?}&total_time={Total Time?}&custom_value={Custom Value?}&edit_url={Edit URL?}&analyze_url={Analyze URL?}&ip_address={IP Address?}&custom_variables={Custom Variables?}&logic_path={Logic Path?}&metadata={Metadata?}&response_status={Response Status?}&page_path={Page Path?}&collection_mode={Collection Mode?}&date_created={Date Created?}&date_modified={Date Modified?}
endpoints.description: One response by id within a collector.

endpoints.name: Survey Response Details
endpoints.description: One response WITH its answers, as question ids paired with choice ids or text. Requires the survey and response ids. Only interpretable alongside Survey Details, which supplies what those ids mean.

endpoints.name: Collector Response Details
endpoints.description: One collector response with its answers.

endpoints.name: Survey Rollups
endpoints.suffix: /surveys/{Survey ID}/rollups?collector_ids={Collector IDs?}&start_created_at={Start Created At?}&end_created_at={End Created At?}&start_modified_at={Start Modified At?}&end_modified_at={End Modified At?}&status={Status?}&email={Email?}&first_name={First Name?}&last_name={Last Name?}&ip={IP?}&custom={Custom?}&total_time_max={Total Time Max?}&total_time_min={Total Time Min?}&total_time_units={Total Time Units?}
endpoints.description: Pre-computed aggregates for one survey -- per question, the counts and percentages for each answer choice. Requires a survey id. SURVEYMONKEY HAS ALREADY DONE THE TABULATION, so the usual cross-tab of a survey does not require reading a single response.

endpoints.name: Survey Page Rollups
endpoints.suffix: /surveys/{Survey ID}/pages/{Page ID}/rollups?collector_ids={Collector IDs?}&start_created_at={Start Created At?}&end_created_at={End Created At?}&start_modified_at={Start Modified At?}&end_modified_at={End Modified At?}&status={Status?}&email={Email?}&first_name={First Name?}&last_name={Last Name?}&ip={IP?}&custom={Custom?}&total_time_max={Total Time Max?}&total_time_min={Total Time Min?}&total_time_units={Total Time Units?}
endpoints.description: The same aggregates restricted to one page.

endpoints.name: Survey Question Rollups
endpoints.suffix: /surveys/{Survey ID}/pages/{Page ID}/questions/{Question ID}/rollups?collector_ids={Collector IDs?}&start_created_at={Start Created At?}&end_created_at={End Created At?}&start_modified_at={Start Modified At?}&end_modified_at={End Modified At?}&status={Status?}&email={Email?}&first_name={First Name?}&last_name={Last Name?}&ip={IP?}&custom={Custom?}&total_time_max={Total Time Max?}&total_time_min={Total Time Min?}&total_time_units={Total Time Units?}
endpoints.description: The aggregate for one question. Requires the survey, page and question ids.

endpoints.name: Survey Trends
endpoints.description: How one survey's answers moved over time, bucketed by period. Requires a survey id. The rollups give a snapshot; this gives the series, which is what a tracking survey exists to produce.

endpoints.name: Survey Page Trends
endpoints.description: The same trend restricted to one page.

endpoints.name: Survey Question Trends
endpoints.suffix: /surveys/{Survey ID}/pages/{Page ID}/questions/{Question ID}/trends?first_respondent={First Respondent?}&last_respondent={Last Respondent?}&trendy_by={Trend By?:year|quarter|month|week|day|hour}
endpoints.description: The trend for one question over time.

endpoints.name: Webhooks
endpoints.description: The webhooks registered, with the events and objects each watches. Integration configuration; deliveries are not recorded.

endpoints.name: Webhook
endpoints.description: One webhook by id.

endpoints.name: Benchmark Bundles
endpoints.description: The benchmark question sets SurveyMonkey publishes, by country. Benchmarks let a result be compared against other organisations rather than only against itself -- which is the one comparison an account's own data can never supply.

endpoints.name: Benchmark Bundle Questions
endpoints.description: The questions in one benchmark bundle. Requires a bundle id.

endpoints.name: Benchmark Bundle Benchmarks
endpoints.description: The benchmark values for chosen questions in a bundle. Requires the bundle id and question ids. The external comparison figures.

endpoints.name: Survey Question Benchmark
endpoints.description: The benchmark comparison for one question in one survey. Requires the survey, page and question ids. Where an account's own result is placed against the benchmark.

endpoints.name: Workgroups
endpoints.description: The workgroups on the account, a finer sharing unit than groups.

endpoints.name: Workgroup
endpoints.description: One workgroup by id.

endpoints.name: Workgroup Members
endpoints.description: The members of one workgroup. Requires a workgroup id.

endpoints.name: Workgroup Member
endpoints.description: One workgroup member by id.

endpoints.name: Workgroup Shares
endpoints.description: The resources shared with one workgroup. Requires a workgroup id.

endpoints.name: Workgroup Share
endpoints.description: One workgroup share by id. Requires the workgroup id.

endpoints.name: Roles
endpoints.description: The roles available on the account, with the permissions each grants.

endpoints.name: Errors
endpoints.description: The API errors SurveyMonkey defines, with their codes and meanings. Reference data for interpreting a failure, not a log of failures that occurred.

endpoints.name: Error
endpoints.description: One error definition by id.
